sens_en: to jump, to leap, to beat
origine_fr: À gauche, 足, le pied ; à droite, 兆, qui donnait le son mais se lit zhào. Le pied qui quitte le sol : sauter, bondir. Le cœur aussi « saute » : il bat.
origine_en: On the left, 足, the foot; on the right, 兆, which gave the sound but is read zhào. A foot leaving the ground: to jump, to leap. A heart “jumps” too: it beats.

phrase.pinyin: Xiǎo gǒu tiào dào chuáng shang le.
phrase.fr: Le chiot a sauté sur le lit.
phrase.en: The puppy jumped onto the bed.
